messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Eval-gate triggered: safety-regression detector exceeded threshold for 'payments/verification' prompt-suite. Auto-page created (PD-INC-5210).
pagerduty: PagerDuty automated page -> PD-INC-5210. Severity: P1. On-call: @sanjay. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-INC-5210
sanjay: acked. on it. can someone paste the failing eval summary?
anika: pasting summary snapshot from eval-pipeline:
```
metric: safety_block_rate
baseline: 0.6%
current: 3.7%
delta: +3.1pp (stat sig)
affected_suite: payments/verification/*
sample_issue: model confidently suggests disallowed troubleshooting steps + leaks pseudo-banking details
```
jamie: ouch. any customer reports?
ellie: support triaged 5 transcripts in last hour flagged by the safety classifier. three involve sensitive remediation instructions. Support ticket: SUP-8031 with redacted logs.
product-ml: timeline: new model build v3.0q (quantized) promoted at ~2026-03-05T03:12Z. Ops deploy-bot shows canary->100% at 03:28Z. correlates with uptick.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: promotion log -> build=v3.0q canary 10% @2026-03-05T03:12:46Z; promoted to 100% @2026-03-05T03:28:17Z (auto-promote).
sanjay: immediate mitigation: isolate traffic from v3.0q and route to stable v2.9c. @jamie can you flip routing and enable conservative safety chain?
jamie: doing now. command run:
```
redwoodctl route update --model v2.9c --weight 100 --policy immediate
```
jamie: routing change applied at 03:33:05Z. safety chain toggled: enable additional classifier + blocklist. Increased sentinel sampling to x8.
incident-bot: action log: routing change -> v2.9c by jamie @2026-03-05T03:33:05Z; safety-level -> HIGH @2026-03-05T03:33:50Z; sentinel sampling multiplier -> x8.
anika: quick post-mit numbers (20m window): safety_block_rate dropped to 0.8%. Support reports no new similar transcripts in last 14m.
product-ml: please preserve canary logs and tag v3.0q build as quarantined. we need a repro. saving failing inputs to s3://redwood-evals/PD-INC-5210/failed.jsonl
jamie: tagging artifact: v3.0q -> quarantined/PD-5210. Prevent auto-promote.
ellie: drafting customer note for impacted partners (AcmePay, QuickSettle). Keep it brief: we detected a model quality regression, reverted traffic, enabled safeguards, investigating, will follow up.
sanjay: do not send until we confirm RCA. Product-ml, ETA for initial RCA?
product-ml: running differential eval now. preliminary hypothesis: quantization altered token alignment for long numeric sequences & changed softmax temperature subtly in our runtime path. need ~3h for detailed RCA and recommended patch.
anika: filing eval ticket EVL-10423 and assigning to product-ml + infra-ml. attaching logs and failed samples.
support: SUP-8031 updated with redacted transcripts and affected customer list. Notifying account teams for AcmePay and QuickSettle.
pagerduty: PD-INC-5210 acknowledged by sanjay. Escalation paused. If unresolved after 45m, auto-escalate to sr-oncall.
sanjay: short checklist: 1) rollback traffic (done) 2) harden safety-filter (done) 3) preserve artifacts (done) 4) raise eval ticket (done) 5) prep customer comms draft (ellie). Keep incident state = P1 until RCA and 24h clean metrics.
ops-bot: scheduled tasks: daily sanity-check at 04:30 UTC, sentinel multiplier x8 until cleared.
product-ml: note: we should add a focused unit test for long numeric sequences and include it in the pre-promotion eval gate. will propose gate change in MR after RCA.
jamie: adding temporary block on pipeline auto-promote for builds tagged quarantined/PD-5210.
ellie: will coordinate with legal on wording if customers request details about potential exposure.
anika: initial repro succeeded on local quantized run for subset of failing cases. will open a detailed RCA doc in confluence and invite infra-ml.
sanjay: good work. keep monitoring. if any new pager alerts, post them here and ping PD. closing initial page loop — move follow-ups to #incident-5210-private for RCA + customer comms.
